text: Submissions · Sibyl Labs Hackathon Skip to content SIBYL Hackathon Home Scoring Submissions Rules Leaderboard Docs ↗ Register your team ≡ Submissions Submit from your build page. No separate form. The private link you got when you registered is your submission. Open it during the build window, add your repo, demo, and posts, then mark it ready before Sep 10, 23:59 UTC. build window: Sep 1 to Sep 10 What a finished submission includes Four things. Add them to your build page and marking it ready takes five minutes. ✓ Public repo Clean commits and a README with complete setup and run instructions. ✓ 2 to 5 minute demo Show the problem, the product, how it works, and a fresh session recalling earlier state. ✓ Team & partner stacks Name the builders and every Base or Virtuals stack used. ✓ Memory implementation note Explain what your agent persists, recalls, and uses to make decisions. One rubric · one leaderboard How judging works Projects clear a pass/fail gate, then score against four weighted criteria. A genuine PMF bonus adds up to 10, and verified Base and Virtuals stacks then apply the multiplier. 100-pt rubric + 10 PMF bonus = 110 max, before multiplier Memory is load-bearing 40 Innovation & originality 25 Technical execution 20 Pitch & presentation 15 PMF bonus + 10 Memory is load-bearing · 40 % How central and sophisticated the memory use is. Recall is competitive; coordination and dynamic-storage patterns top the band. Innovation & originality · 25 % A novel idea and real usefulness. Clever but useless caps out low. Technical execution · 20 % Clean and robust, no smoke and mirrors. Survives a second run and a curious judge. Pitch & presentation · 15 % A tight 2 to 5 minute story where the load-bearing moment is unmistakable. Verified partner stacks then multiply the weighted score, up to x1.25 .
